headline: LeviLauncher v1.6.1
summary: Added Discord Rich Presence and optional microphone permission, with faster startup and content management and improved Indonesian language support.

items.text: Added Discord Rich Presence to show launcher activity, Minecraft version, and elapsed time. No login required in LeviLauncher.
Added microphone permission for mod developers creating proximity voice chat mods. Disabled by default; enable it in Android's app permissions.
Removed the foreground service. Update to BedrockTools v1.5.11 and enable No Disconnect to keep Minecraft running in the background and skip the loading screen when returning to the app.
Optimised native library extraction and caching to reduce repeated work and speed up Minecraft startup.
Optimised content management for faster pack imports and deletions, world list loading, and content counts.
The home screen now shows Skin Packs instead of Behavior Packs.
Fixed Indonesian locale handling and migrated existing language selections (#396).
